name: nGZSceneGraph::ChooseTextureDescription (cdecl desc, width, height, levels, format, normalMap, kind: the device texture's description for an image or a strategy)
notes: SG_ChooseTextureDescription (3000 seeds: 8 formats with random ARGB / DXT / AL faces and bits, the device enum's support per format and kind, the texture manager's DXT / true-colour flags, normal maps, kinds 3-7, the closest-format search over a range of 0-6 formats with its half-bits retry; the description, the result, the fakes' counts and the heap compared). Also through SG_TextureImageSlots (tests/sg_texture_image.cpp, a stand-in on both sides) and SG_ProceduralTextureSlots. Lane TH, M4b. The format as given (X8R8G8B8 for a normal map) when the device takes it and the flags allow DXT or more than 16 bits; else a DXT image's own format, else the closest colour format (then half the bits); then fitted to the device (0x18c990 2D, 0x18e1d0 cube of the mean edge). Its range copy (0x167180, inline here as CopyRange, as src/gz/cDeviceDX.cpp does) is not hooked. Hooked (32 bytes); its callers (cTextureImage::Restore 0xab5610, cProceduralTexture::Restore 0xab5090) are ours. Mutants (tools/mutate.py, 8 over the chooser: the true-colour 16-bit test, DXT1 alpha, DXT colour bits, the 16-bit clamp, the half-bits retry, the cube's mean edge, the normal-map format, the range rewind): all killed (two after adding 12 and 15 bits per pixel to the generated formats). Not yet tested in-game.

name: nGZSceneGraph::AdjustCubeTextureSize (cdecl device, format, edge*, levels*: fits a cube texture's edge and mip levels to the device caps)
notes: Hooked (nGZSceneGraph_AdjustCubeTextureSize, 32 bytes, CRC 0xa90cd858, not in-game tested). The device's enum asked for its enum face (iid 0x6c02c311), the current caps read, the edge floored at 1, rounded up to a power of two with CUBEMAP_POW2, to a multiple of 4 for DXT and 2 for YUV, held to the smaller of the caps' max width and height (unsigned min, signed hold); without MIPCUBEMAP levels is 1, else clamped to 0.. and held to the halving count of the edge; the face released. A failed query faults on a null face (ORIGINAL-BUG, not covered). DIFF_TEST SG_AdjustCubeTextureSize (3000 seeds over random caps words, edges incl. zero and negative, formats DXT / YUV / other, levels incl. negative; edge, levels, call log compared) plus SG_ChooseTextureDescription with ours stood in. Mutants (tools/mutate.py, 11 of 11 killed): pow2 flag swapped, smear step dropped, DXT multiple, YUV multiple, signed min compare, width-only limit, mip count off by one, negative levels unclamped, no-mip levels 0, release dropped, edge floor dropped. Its only caller is ChooseTextureDescription (ours).

name: nGZSceneGraph::AdjustTextureSize (cdecl device, format, width*, height*, levels*, allowNonPow2: fits a 2D texture's size and mip levels to the device caps)
notes: Lane VG. Hooked (nGZSceneGraph_AdjustTextureSize, 32 bytes, CRC 0xacf9c527, not in-game tested): the game's cRenderTargetTexture::Restore 0xab5240, cPatternBrush vf3 0x153ae0 and 0x37b3d0 call it; ours from ChooseTextureDescription and cDraw2D::PlaceRecord (no longer through OriginalFunction). The device's enum asked for its enum face, the current caps read; any size when the last argument (a byte) allows it, the caps have POW2 and NONPOW2CONDITIONAL and the format isn't DXT; each side floored at 1; with POW2 (not any size) rounded up to a power of two, or (allowed and both above 32) down to one; DXT multiples of 4, YUV an even width; the caps' maxima (signed); the aspect ratio (SQUAREONLY 1, else MaxTextureAspectRatio, none when 0) raising the shorter side (unsigned division); levels 1 for any size or without MIPMAP, else held to 0.. the halvings until both sides are 1; the face released when there is one. DIFF_TEST SG_AdjustTextureSize (4000 seeds x 3; the four branches counted, each at least 100) plus SG_ChooseTextureDescription and the cDraw2D tests with ours stood in. Mutants (lane VG, tools/mutate.py --filter SG_AdjustTextureSize, 16 of 16 killed): DXT ignored in the any-size test, one cap bit for it, height floor dropped, the 32 threshold moved, the round-down smear of x-1, a smear step dropped, DXT height not rounded, YUV on the height, unsigned maximum, square-only ignored, signed aspect division, h<=w, levels ignoring any-size, the level loop on the width only, negative levels kept, the face release dropped.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cPixelFormatRange copy constructor (the cursor cloned and counted)
notes: Lane WN (lane WI's leftover). Game code, not library.
